question: An example of a series circuit is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**decoration lights**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When resistors are connected with only one conducting path they are said to be connected in series. 
 
• The same current flows through all resistances but the voltage drop will be different and proportional to the resistance. 
 
• Total voltage is equal to the sum of voltage drops across individual resistors.

The total resistance in a series circuit is given as
